description: A Stripe Customer Portal link for your account: payment method, invoices and cancellation. To cancel, call it with cancel: true (and accounts: "all" for every account you own): that changes nothing and answers the accounts with their businesses, a warning to read to the person, and a confirmation_id. Only after they say yes, call it again with just the confirmation_id for one cancellation link per account. billing_not_enabled until billing starts.

account.description: The account to act for, by its owner's email or the domain of a business it tracks, as list_businesses shows them. Needed only when you're on more than one account's team.

accounts.description: With cancel: every account you own, instead of one.

cancel.description: Ask to cancel: answers the warning and a confirmation_id, and changes nothing.

confirmation_id.description: The id the cancel call answered, alone, after the person said yes.

name: billing_portal_link
title: Get the billing portal link
